describe: the pavement people walk on beside a city street, seen straight down, tidy and in good repair, with no grid, rows, lines or direction of any kind

looks.describe: a city footway's asphalt: mid grey, clearly lighter and finer than a road's, a tight fine grain of tiny pale and dark specks, soft broad variations of tone
the same footway asphalt a little more used: soft lighter worn patches where people walk, a few small faint dark gum spots, no leaves

trial.describe: light warm grey poured concrete, one continuous surface, a fine sandy grain
the same concrete a little more used: a shade darker, soft faint grime and a very few small faint dark spots
light cool grey city concrete in one continuous surface, painted with soft broad mottling of lighter and darker greys, a fine grain, a few small dark gum spots
the same city concrete a little more used: soft grime patches, more small dark gum spots, a very few tiny fallen leaves and faint hairline cracks curving every way
light grey terrazzo-like concrete: a smooth pale grey base densely set with small chips of white, grey, charcoal and a few soft blue-grey, 1 to 2 cm across, ground flat
the same terrazzo-like concrete a little more used: soft grime patches and a few small faint dark spots, still smooth
